Claim 1 (Currently amended): A method of providing information regarding a product, the method comprising: receiving a unique identifier identifying a package containing a product, wherein the unique identifier is stored on the package.

Claim 19 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein the unique identifier comprises a first unique identifier, the method further comprising: reading a second unique identifier identifying a user, wherein the second unique identifier is stored on a user device.

Claim 23 (Currently amended): The method of claim 22, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information customized to the role of the user, wherein the role of the user is defined by the user profile associated with the unique identifier.

Claim 24 (Currently amended): The method of claim 1, wherein generating the at least use information comprises generating the at least use information of a type customized for the user based on the user profile associated with the unique identifier.
